macros.name: absposset
macros.doc: Sets the options, as described under \absput, to the value they should have within the current group (or globally, if not inside a group).

macros.name: absput
macros.doc: Places ⟨contents⟩ at some position (possibly scaled or rotated) as dictated by the optional ⟨options⟩, supplied as keys and key–value pairs.
